name: Stakeholder whiteboard
definition: Sticky notes around a central note for the presenter’s role, joined by labeled wires describing each working relationship.

demo.how: The presenter sits on the central note and each stakeholder is a sticky joined by a wire that names the working relationship. Click a sticky, or use the arrow keys, to highlight its wire and read the cadence and who brings what; Reset clears the selection. Roles are illustrative.
